title: Add version control URI schemes to registerProtocolHandler safelist

labels.name: needs tests
labels.description: Moving the issue forward requires someone to write tests

body:
This allows sites to register protocol handlers for version control
repositories.

I've confirmed uses of every one of these schemes in the wild.
